images.caption: Figure 1:Rubric-reward failures under GRPO onRubric-Mix-10katQwen3.5-4B, and harness-controlled RL training inHarnessRL: failure classes for one criterion (top left), class proportions and GRPO’s training reward against oracle quality on held-out tasks (bottom left), and harness(pt,gt,ct)(p_{t},g_{t},c_{t})-controlled RL training (right).SSdenotes the judge’s binary criterion scores andQQthe oracle ranking of the rollouts.

Figure 2:HarnessRLruns an RL loop conditioned on a training-time harnessℋ=t(pt,gt,ct)\mathcal{H}{}_{t}=(p_{t},g_{t},c_{t}), which controls task sampling, rollout guidance and the rubric, respectively.
The harness co-evolves with the policy: it retrieves evidence from the training-time memoryℳt\mathcal{M}_{t}, attributes failures, and is iteratively refined by a proposer and JIT critic loop.
